question: How to Set VFD Acceleration, Deceleration and V/f Ratio?
body_html:
VFD parameter configuration centres on acceleration time, deceleration time and the V/f ratio; wrong values cause trips or overheating.

ParameterToo Short or HighToo Long or Low
Acceleration timeOvercurrent trip at startLow speed overheating
Deceleration timeOvervoltage tripLoad coasts and overruns
V/f ratioSaturation, overheatingLow torque, stall

Minimum ramp: t = (J × n) ÷ (9.55 × T_acc). With J = 2 kg·m², n = 1500 rpm and 100 Nm, t = 3000 ÷ 955 ≈ 3.1 s; set 20 to 50% longer.
